classification.difficultyReason: Use known entries to recover the missing row and column factors and complete the multiplication table, the same task as the earlier table question with larger numbers but no extra decision.

answer.worked:
Find missing factors by dividing a supplied product by its known factor. Determine each sign separately from its magnitude.
$$\begin{align*}32\div4&=8\\-36\div4&=-9\\88\div8&=11\\-77\div11&=-7\\21\div(-7)&=-3\\39\div(-3)&=-13\end{align*}$$
The column factors are $-13,-7,-9,8$, and the row factors are $11,4,-3,-2$.
$$\begin{align*}11\times(-13)&=-143\\11\times(-9)&=-99\\4\times(-13)&=-52\\4\times(-7)&=-28\\(-3)\times(-9)&=27\\(-3)\times8&=-24\\(-2)\times(-13)&=26\\(-2)\times(-7)&=14\\(-2)\times(-9)&=18\\(-2)\times8&=-16\end{align*}$$
